review.purpose: Eighteen existing current-ASv6.100 controls for essential processes, explicitly selected methods, readiness and planned versus completed states. The eight complete rocket entries run separately with their own coherent baseline.
criteria: Preserve each selected topic's identity and independently chosen supported boundaries; making all features optional or returning a vaguer meaning is not success.
Retain making risotto, exploratory activity and listening's hearing process. An explicitly named oven method remains required even when other preparation techniques or equipment are optional.

Preserve ongoing simmering, food readiness and particular planned versus completed states where the original post establishes them. General category definitions must not assert unmentioned particular methods or occurrences.
Compare each whole independently generated child with the exact independently generated meanings of all selected ancestors in this control panel; keep nulls and supported conflicts visible.
Historical answers and human judgments are evidence to reconsider, not required labels. Keep producer support, chosen-boundary expression and branch compatibility separate.
